settings.label: Which of my lists
settings.description: Only the items on these lists are shown. Nothing ticked means all of them. Films have no watching or hold list.

settings.label: How many entries
settings.description: The canvas asks for this many at a time and loads more as you scroll.

settings.label: SIMKL client id
settings.description: From the SIMKL app you create. It is public, but it is kept on this computer beside the token.

settings.label: SIMKL access token
settings.description: The token SIMKL gives your app once you approve it at simkl.com/pin.

auth.note: SIMKL's sign-in finishes on simkl.com: create an app, approve it there, and paste the access token here. Both are kept by the helper on this computer; nothing about them reaches your account.
